verdict.rationale: smolagents documents running agent-generated code in sandboxed environments (Modal, Blaxel, E2B, Docker) and ships a hardened LocalPythonExecutor. That gives real execution isolation from the host, but the evidence never shows a test or staging mode that keeps agents away from production data: tools can still call live systems, and isolating data is left to the user. missing for 10: a documented test/staging environment separating agent runs from production data, guidance on keeping tools off live systems, and independent hands-on corroboration of the sandbox integrations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: To make it secure, we support executing in sandboxed environment via Modal, Blaxel, E2B, or Docker.
